# Dictionary Api

The Merriam-Webster Dictionary API provides developers with access to comprehensive dictionary and thesaurus content, including definitions, etymologies, audio pronunciations, synonyms, and antonyms.

Category: Other. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/dictionary-api/.

## Actions

- **Get Word Definition V2** (read-only): Retrieve definitions, phonetics, origin, and meanings of a given word using freedictionaryapi v2.
